subject: interval reporting rule: plan versus first implementation
plan_text: copeland_plan.json, reporting_rule.shared_encoding_interval_support: report a direction only when, for every encoding in the uncertainty set and every cross-replicate profile pair between the two conditions, the lower bound of one exceeds the upper bound of the other by epsilon
first_implementation: copeland_evaluate.py (14 September 2026) pooled the intervals of all encodings of a condition and required every interval of one condition to clear every interval of the other; this compares encodings with each other as well as profiles and is stricter than the planned rule
found_by: external methods review of 16 September 2026, by recalculation from the saved intervals
repair: copeland_rule.shared_encoding_direction implements the planned rule; copeland_evaluate.py now reports both rules side by side (columns interval_direction_shared and interval_direction_pooled; summary keys without suffix follow the planned rule, keys with _pooled the stricter rule); five known-answer tests were added for the planned rule

effect_on_results.fixed_fraction_task: unchanged: 0 of 8 reported under both rules for every encoding family
effect_on_results.measured_growth_task: unchanged: 8 of 8 reported under both rules for the five-power and six-encoding families, 4 of 8 for the uniform reference
effect_on_results.condition_independent_mean_task: five-power family: 1 of 8 under the planned rule (glucose, oxygen contrast under vehicle, 21 percent numerically above 0.5 percent, separation at most 0.004 units) against 0 of 8 under the pooled rule; this contrast is not measurement-eligible; six-encoding family and uniform reference unchanged at 0 of 8

outputs.evaluation and evaluation_meantask: the 14 September outputs, kept unchanged for the record
